delay_notice.subject: PlotArt payment pilot · PA-O-261118-SD000B · processing fee reimbursement: Stripe has not yet recorded the fee
delay_notice.body:
Order PA-O-261118-SD000B

Stripe confirmed your buyer’s payment on Sunday 8 November 2026. PlotArt reimburses Stripe’s processing fee, and the VAT Stripe charges on it, within seven calendar days of the payment: for this order, by the end of Sunday 15 November 2026 (Irish time).

We have not yet been able to confirm the fee Stripe charged on this payment, so we do not yet know the exact amount. PlotArt does not estimate it.

If Stripe had not recorded the fee by the end of Sunday 15 November 2026, PlotArt will reimburse it at the latest by the end of the seventh calendar day after the day Stripe records it (Irish time). For example, if Stripe records it on Thursday 19 November 2026, the latest date is Thursday 26 November 2026. If Stripe’s records show that it had recorded the fee by Sunday 15 November 2026, that date still applies, and we will tell you.

We will write again with the amount and the date that applies when the reimbursement is made. Your payout from Stripe to your bank is separate and follows your usual Stripe payout schedule.

This message comes from the PlotArt payment pilot (test mode).
